citations.assessment: The section gives Tanhum’s questions to Yose and preserves the exchange. In digital 3:12:9 Mana asks Berekhiah why he did not sign, then says that had he known the teaching he would not have signed and they would have said the pupil opposed his teacher. Warsaw compresses and changes the conditional; keep the variant explicit.
